hotel_1star_proxy.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Rio de Janeiro? Hotel Prices for Rio de Janeiro, Brazil | Budget Your Trip
hotel_1star_proxy.evidenceText: The exact Rio de Janeiro hotel-price search snippet reports $81 as the average price of 293 1-star hotels and $62 median. It describes a one-night stay and states that all hotel prices are in US Dollars before taxes, based on a Kayak-reported base price; star-rating prices are before taxes and fees.
hotel_1star_proxy.referencePeriod: BudgetYourTrip hotel-price analysis; page crawled last month; prices vary seasonally and are before taxes and fees.
